title: KOREA MARITIME TRANSPORTATION SAFETY AUTHORITY ACT

KOREA MARITIME TRANSPORTATION SAFETY AUTHORITY ACT

AI_DRAFT / DRAFT_NEEDS_REVIEW
Korean source version: 206378
Not a certified or officially endorsed English translation.

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to contribute to protecting the lives, physical well-being, and property of the people by establishing the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority, having it conduct projects for preventing maritime traffic accidents and projects supporting the operation and management of maritime transportation systems, and thereby ensuring maritime transportation safety.

Article 2 (Legal Personality)
The Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority (hereinafter referred to as the "Authority") shall be a corporation.

Article 3 (Offices)
(1) The location of the principal office of the Authority shall be prescribed by its articles of incorporation.
(2) The Authority may establish branches, business offices, research institutes, educational institutes, and other offices as prescribed by its articles of incorporation.

Article 4 (Registration of Establishment)
(1) The Authority shall be established upon completing registration of its establishment at the location of its principal office.
(2) Matters necessary for registration of establishment and other registration of the Authority shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 5 (Officers)
(1) The Authority shall have not more than 11 directors, including a chairperson, and one auditor as its officers.
(2) The chairperson shall represent the Authority and exercise general supervision over its affairs.

Article 6 (Advisory Bodies)
(1) The Authority may establish advisory bodies to obtain advice on matters necessary for performing its duties.
(2) Members of an advisory body shall be commissioned by the chairperson following a resolution of the board of directors.
(3) Matters necessary for the organization and operation of advisory bodies, other than those prescribed in this Act, shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 7 (Appointment and Dismissal of Employees)
Employees of the Authority shall be appointed or dismissed by the chairperson as prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

Article 8 (Duty to Maintain Confidentiality)
No current or former officer or employee of the Authority shall disclose or misappropriate confidential information learned in the course of performing duties.

Article 9 (Business Activities)
The Authority shall perform the following activities:
1. Education, public enlightenment, broadcasting, and public relations concerning maritime transportation safety;
2. Development, dissemination, and support of technology for maritime transportation safety, and introduction of foreign technology;
3. Collection, investigation, and research of data concerning maritime transportation safety, and international cooperation;
4. Duties, including ship inspections, performed on behalf of or entrusted by the State or a local government pursuant to statutes, regulations, etc.;
5. Undertaking research services concerning maritime transportation safety under contract;
6. Projects concerning maritime traffic safety examinations and the improvement of maritime transportation systems;
7. Investigation, testing, and research to ensure the seaworthiness of ships and the safety of human life at sea, and development and dissemination of related technology;
8. Research on technical standards and ship inspection systems under international conventions on ship safety;
9. Performance certification of ships and ship equipment, and projects for developing new technologies, including eco-friendly ships;
10. Duties concerning the management of greenhouse gas and air pollutant emissions from ships;
11. Contract services, including ship design and construction supervision;
12. Management of the safe operation of passenger ships under the Marine Transportation Act;
13. Projects concerning the operation of and provision of information through maritime traffic and ship information systems;
14. Other projects appropriate to the purpose for which the Authority is established and designated or approved by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries;
15. Projects incidental to the activities specified in subparagraphs 1 through 13.

Article 10 (Financing)
Funds required for the operation and business activities of the Authority shall be raised in the following ways:
1. Contributions or subsidies from the Government, local governments, or other persons;
2. Revenue generated from projects under Article 9;
3. Donations, loans, or borrowed funds (including funds borrowed from abroad and materials introduced from abroad);
4. Income from asset management;
5. Other revenue.

Article 11 (Capital Contributions, etc.)
(1) Where necessary for efficiently performing its projects, the Authority may make capital contributions or other contributions to fields related to the projects under Article 9 following a resolution of the board of directors.
(2) Matters necessary for capital contributions or other contributions under paragraph (1) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 12 (Borrowing of Funds)
Where necessary for projects under Article 9, the Authority may borrow funds or import materials with the approval of the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries.

Article 13 (Collection of Fees, etc.)
The Authority may collect fees and other actual expenses in connection with projects under Article 9 and facilities it manages.

Article 14 (Approval of Business Operation Plans, etc.)
The Authority shall prepare a business plan and a proposed budget for each business year and obtain approval from the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. The same shall apply to any amendment thereto.

Article 15 (Requests for Relevant Materials, etc.)
Where necessary in implementing projects under Article 9, the Authority may request relevant administrative agencies, local governments, or other necessary persons to allow inspection or copying of relevant materials, such as documents, or to provide other necessary cooperation.

Article 16 (Guidance and Supervision)
(1) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall provide guidance and supervision to the Authority concerning the following matters:
1. Matters concerning the appropriate performance of projects under Article 9;
2. Other matters prescribed by other statutes and regulations.
(2) Where the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries discovers an unlawful or improper fact as a result of guidance and supervision under paragraph (1), the Minister may order the Authority to rectify the matter.
(3) A public official conducting guidance and supervision under paragraph (1) shall carry an identification certificate indicating his or her authority and present it to the relevant persons.

Article 17 (Prohibition on Use of Similar Names)
No person other than the Authority established under this Act shall use the name "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority" or any name similar thereto.

Article 18 (Application Mutatis Mutandis of the Civil Act)
Except as otherwise provided in this Act or the Act on the Management of Public Institutions, the provisions concerning incorporated foundations in the Civil Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to the Authority.

Article 19 (Deemed Public Officials for Application of Penalty Provisions)
Officers and employees of the Authority shall be deemed public officials for purposes of applying Articles 129 through 132 of the Criminal Act.

Article 20 (Penalty Provisions)
A person who violates Article 8 shall be punished by imprisonment with labor for not more than two years or by a fine not exceeding 20 million won.

Article 21 (Administrative Fines)
(1) A person who violates Article 17 shall be subject to an administrative fine not exceeding five million won.
(2) Administrative fines under paragraph (1) shall be imposed and collected by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.

ADDENDA <Act No. 16160, December 31, 2018>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force six months after the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Succession to Property, Rights, and Obligations, etc.)
(1) Upon the establishment of the Authority under this Act, the Authority shall comprehensively succeed to all property, rights, and obligations belonging to the Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority.
(2) The name of the Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority entered in registries and other official documents and books concerning property, rights, and obligations comprehensively succeeded under paragraph (1) shall be deemed the name of the Authority under this Act from the time of its establishment.
(3) Projects, dispositions, and other acts undertaken by the Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority at the time this Act enters into force, and applications and other acts made to the Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority, shall be deemed acts of the Authority under this Act or acts made to that Authority, respectively.

Article 3 (Special Rules for Dissolution and Liquidation)
Notwithstanding the provisions on dissolution and liquidation in the Civil Act, the Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority shall be deemed dissolved upon completion of registration of the establishment of the Authority under this Act.

Article 4 (Transitional Measures concerning Designation as a Public Institution, etc.)
(1) A designation of the Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority as a public institution by the Minister of Economy and Finance under the Act on the Management of Public Institutions at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed a designation of the Authority under this Act.
(2) An agreement concluded by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries with the Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority concerning the performance of inspection and related duties on behalf of the Minister under the latter part of Article 60 (1), other than the subparagraphs, of the Ship Safety Act at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed an agreement concluded with the Authority under this Act.

Article 5 (Transitional Measures concerning Gratuitous Lease or Gratuitous Use and Profit)
The Authority under this Act shall succeed to the gratuitous lease of State-owned property or goods to the Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority, or permission granted to that Authority for the gratuitous use of or profit from such property or goods, under the previous Article 56 (2) of the Ship Safety Act.

Article 6 (Transitional Measures concerning Officers and Employees)
Officers and employees of the Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed officers and employees of the Authority under this Act. In such cases, the terms of office of officers shall be the remaining terms of office under the Act on the Management of Public Institutions.

Article 7 (Transitional Measures concerning Penalties, etc.)
The previous provisions of the Ship Safety Act shall apply to the imposition of penalties and administrative fines for acts committed before this Act enters into force.

Article 8 (Amendment of Other Acts)
(1) Part of the Act on the Development and Management of Marinas shall be amended as follows:
In Article 35 (3), "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority under Article 45 of the Ship Safety Act" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act".

(2) Part of the Ship Management Industry Development Act shall be amended as follows:
Article 10 (2) 4 shall be amended as follows:
4. The Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act and classification societies designated under Article 60 of the Ship Safety Act.

(3) Part of the Ship Act shall be amended as follows:
In the part of Article 29-2 (1) other than the subparagraphs thereof, "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority under Article 45 of the Ship Safety Act (hereinafter referred to as the 'Authority') and the same Act" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act (hereinafter referred to as the 'Authority') and the Ship Safety Act".

(4) Part of the Ship Safety Act shall be amended as follows:
The heading "CHAPTER VII KOREA SHIP SAFETY TECHNOLOGY AUTHORITY" immediately preceding Article 45 shall be deleted.
Articles 45, 46, 48, 50, 54 through 56, 58, 58-2, 58-3, and 59 shall be deleted respectively.
In the first sentence of the part of Article 60 (1) other than the subparagraphs thereof, "Authority" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act (hereinafter referred to as the 'Authority')".
Article 85, subparagraph 1-2, and Article 89 (2), subparagraph 26-2, shall be deleted respectively.

(5) Part of the Ballast Water Management Act shall be amended as follows:
In the first sentence of the part of Article 30 (1) other than the subparagraphs thereof, "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority under Article 45 of the Ship Safety Act (hereinafter referred to as the 'Authority') or the same Act" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act (hereinafter referred to as the 'Authority') or the Ship Safety Act".

(6) Part of the Act on Search and Rescue, etc. in Water shall be amended as follows:
In Article 28, subparagraph 1, "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act".

(7) Part of the Fishing Vessels Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 40 (2), "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority established under Article 45 of the Ship Safety Act" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act".

(8) Part of the Harbor Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 29-3 (3), "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority".

(9) Part of the Marine Environment Management Act shall be amended as follows:
In the first sentence of the part of Article 112 (1) other than the subparagraphs thereof, "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority under Article 45 of the Ship Safety Act (hereinafter referred to as the 'Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority') or the same Act" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act (hereinafter referred to as the 'Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority') or the Ship Safety Act"; and in the first sentence of paragraph (2) of the same Article, "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority".

(10) Part of the Marine Transportation Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 22 (2), "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority established under Article 45 of the Ship Safety Act" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act".

Article 9 (Relationship to Other Statutes and Regulations)
Where another statute or regulation cites the Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority at the time this Act enters into force, the citation shall be deemed a citation of the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority under this Act.
